entries.title: Dynamic Memory Pooling, Allocation and Sharing in CXL-Based Disaggregated Memory
entries.summary: CXL-based disaggregated memory enables a shift from server-attached memory to a shared, fabric-attached resource pool. As a result, memory can be dynamically allocated, shared across compute nodes, and utilized more efficiently across heterogeneous workloads.
